newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn up on oversold ideas, short covering.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn up on oversold ideas, short covering.

text.p: CBOT corn futures showed modest gains early Friday in a technical bounce and short covering before the weekend, traders said.
Rallies should be capped by forecasts for warm and rainy weather this weekend, sources said. Those conditions are seen as nearly ideal for the new crop.
Long-term forecasts, including Thursday's National Weather Service 30- and 90-day outlooks, indicated no crop weather problems and were also seen limiting gains, traders said.
"The 30- and 90-day forecasts are a little bearish," a trader said.
In early trade, Cargill bought two million July and Refco bought 2.5 million December. LIT sold two million bushels July and bought one million December, pit traders said.
At 1005 CDT, July corn was 1/4 cent per bushel higher at $2.65-1/2 per bushel, and other months were one to 1/2 cent higher.
